title: OCI cache configuration without pipeline cache scripts
expected: A standalone user configures only an OCI destination.
Cold build stores complete blobs/results; warm build restores verified content; unavailable cache falls back to computation.

cases.name: concurrent-writers
cases.change: Publish incompatible outputs for the same action key.
cases.expect: Record conflict; never silently overwrite trusted results.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
